about_the_game:
The Train Goes Right, you know what to do.

Step into the mid-19th century and take on the role of a railway pioneer in Train Goes Right, a casual yet immersive co-op adventure where the train never stops—unless you do! In this charming low-poly world, you’ll build an endless railway, one rail at a time, while operating a faithfully simplified steam train. The primary controls of the locomotive are represented, giving you just the right level of interaction to keep the train moving forward without overwhelming complexity. Whether you prefer to play alone or team up with friends, Train Goes Right offers both local and online co-op so you can lay rail at your own pace. Don’t like trains? That’s fine too—we left you a handcart in the corner.

Key Features:

  • Chop, Haul, Build!
    Start by chopping down trees in the forest and hauling the logs back to the train. Exchange the logs for railroad ties and rails at the station.

  • Operate a Steam Train
    Experience the challenge and satisfaction of operating a steam locomotive with simplified yet authentic controls. Manage speed, keep the fire stoked, and keep an eye on that water level.

  • Simple, Satisfying Gameplay Loop
    Experience the simple joy of chopping, building, and hammering your way to progress. Return to the start of the line to upgrade your supplies and prepare for the next leg of the journey.

  • Detailed Jobs
    There are no small jobs on the railroad, and no task is free. Cutting down a tree is only the start; players still need to remove the branches and divide the trunk. Rails need ballast (rocks) laid between the ties, and the firebox must be kept fueled with coal.

  • Work Never Ends 
    The tracks stretch on forever. How far will you take the train?

In Train Goes Right, it’s not just about keeping the train moving—it’s about finding joy in the work, the progress you've made, and the rolling the stock. Whether you’re driving the train or hammering in the next rail, this laid-back game invites you to celebrate the age of the steam locomotive, one track at a time.

Are you ready to strike that first tie? You know which way to go.

short_description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
